mintAuthority.summary: Noble USDN is an M0-backed Noble deployment; base M issuance remains on the Ethereum MinterGateway and Noble movement uses M0 portal infrastructure.

upgradeability.controlRef: M0 Noble Portal owner Safe (upgrade control)

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway backing rail
controls.capDescription: Base M issuance backing Noble USDN depends on approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and M0 collateral/debt checks.

routeChecks.attestorQuorum: M0 docs describe validator attestations before minting; this review did not enumerate the live validator threshold.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: MinterGateway minting is bounded by approved-Minter status, collateral/debt checks, and mint-delay review before MToken mint.
routeChecks.caps: Per-Minter capacity can be changed by M0 TTG governance, so the cap is protocol-governed rather than immutable.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: MinterGateway is confirmed immutable/non-proxy; cap governance remains with M0 TTG and Registrar governance.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295161: Blockscout confirms ContractName=MinterGateway, IsProxy=false (immutable, non-upgradeable). EIP-1967 admin and impl slots both zero. No external admin or module surface; cap governance rests with M0 TTG (POWER token holders).

controls.label: M0 Noble Portal
controls.capDescription: M0 deployments list the Noble Portal on Ethereum for Noble movement; base supply remains governed by the Ethereum MinterGateway.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: Noble USDN movement uses M0 Portal infrastructure; base M supply remains governed by the Ethereum MinterGateway.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: Local bridge review identifies the M0/Noble route but does not enumerate live remote peer configuration.
routeChecks.caps: Portal capacity is treated as bounded by the M0 base supply and portal route, not by an immutable token-level cap.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The portal's owner-controlled upgrade path is represented separately by the M0 Noble Portal owner Safe (upgrade control).

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531314, the Noble Portal remained the Ethereum-side M0 bridge contract for Noble movement. Its EIP-1967 implementation resolved to 0xa6fab688fe4e5f7a9d310dce7ae8e88792692fb4, its admin slot was zero, and owner() resolved to the separately reviewed upgrade Safe. Base M issuance remains governed by MinterGateway rather than the portal owner.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531314, Noble Portal owner() returned 0x7176665e336e8692e9b265aB6290934C93F99cCf. The verified implementation delegates portal upgrades to owner authority. Fixed-block calls and the Safe service confirmed a 2-of-2 Safe with the two listed EOA owners, no enabled modules, and zero guard and module guard.

sources.label: Safe Transaction Service Noble Portal owner

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531314, the immutable MinterGateway remained the base-M issuance rail and the Noble Portal remained the bridge control for Noble movement. The portal implementation was 0xa6fab688fe4e5f7a9d310dce7ae8e88792692fb4 with no external ProxyAdmin; owner() returned Safe 0x7176665e336e8692e9b265aB6290934C93F99cCf, which separately controls upgrades. The Safe was 2-of-2 with owners 0xb4518ae2F26ed79648C32734E0fC1F91bBF76459 and 0xDAB03eA17203d786588b9217ccC30664e7294Bd2, no enabled modules, and zero guard and module guard. Noble remains Cosmos-based, so M management is Ethereum-side.
